title: runtime: a REST call placed only by its scoped URL forwards a same-origin type:'api' action with no routing identity (401 on a shared-origin multi-kernel host)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwJbS8sZAfru2iyvQq

Filing gate: ① product defect, class a, reproduced by the #32658 dev on the branch of PR #32882 (Acceptance notes). Same class as #32658, at the REST door. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.
reach: public entry `POST /environments/:env/actions/:object/:action` on a shared-origin multi-kernel host whose clients address an environment by the scoped URL (no hostname binding), for a same-origin `type: 'api'` action.

## What happens (measured through the real `dispatch()` on the #32882 branch rig)

`POST /environments/env_t/actions/ad_task/probe_api`, `Host: shared.example.test` (no hostname binding), the caller's session → `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`. The forward reached the raw app as `http://shared.example.test/api/v1/probe/echo` with no `X-Environment-Id`, so it was placed in no environment.

## Expected

The forward carries the environment the request was placed in, as PR #32882 does at the host door (`X-Environment-Id` written from the resolver's placement, never the caller's spelling; nothing for no placement, `platform` or a single kernel). The REST and MCP doors run the api arm with different deps from the host door, so the fix belongs where the scoped-URL placement is known.

## Business reason

On a shared-origin host, a member who runs an api action from an environment addressed by URL gets 401 for an action the same member may run, so the action looks broken.

Dedupe words: `api action forward scoped url environment`, `forward X-Environment-Id REST door`, `shared origin api forward 401`.
Related: #32658 (PR #32882), cloud#4351.
